title: Lifting a prescribed Cohen-ring residue isomorphism
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring complete for its maximal ideal m [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], whose residue field has characteristic p. Let C be a Cohen ring for p [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and e: C/pC -> R/m a ring isomorphism. There exists a ring homomorphism f: C -> R whose reduction modulo m is e composed with reduction modulo pC.

source.place: Algebra, Theorem Tag 032A(1), second proof paragraph, using Lemma Tag 0329

proof.text: For a square-zero ideal J of a ring D with p^n=0, any ring map C -> D/J factors through C/p^n because it kills the generator p^n. Apply the explicit ring-map lifting clause of Cohen-ring formal smoothness, then precompose the lift with C -> C/p^n.

Since p lies in m, p^(n+2) is zero in D=R/m^(n+2). The ideal J which is the image of m^(n+1) in D is square-zero since 2(n+1) >= n+2. The double quotient D/J is isomorphic to R/m^(n+1). Apply the previous step to lift any map C -> R/m^(n+1) into R/m^(n+2), compatibly.

Start with e composed with C -> C/pC and transport its target to R/m^1. Dependent recursion chooses a compatible map at each successor. IsAdicComplete.StrictMono.liftRingHom gives the map C -> R from this compatible sequence; its degree-zero component (exponent one) gives the required residue equality.
